C0452.title: China's Supreme Court Rules Banks Must Compensate for Unauthorized Card Transactions
C0452.summary: In May 2021, China's Supreme People's Court issued a judicial interpretation clarifying that banks bear liability for unauthorized transactions. The rules categorize fraud into counterfeit card fraud and online payment fraud, requiring issuing banks to compensate cardholders who are not at fault, providing a clear legal basis for victims.

references.title: Supreme People's Court clarifies: Banks must compensate for unauthorized card transactions, netizens say 'It's about time'
